notes.title: 1.0 is coming soon
notes.content:
Annnnnnnnd we're back! 

After a long hiatus it's time to give the PC version of ZWG a little (lot?) of love. The last few months have been focused on the mobile release of the game. I'm certainly glad to have put ZWG out for the iOS and Android platforms, but holy smokes was that a lot of work. 

It's time to get back and focus on my fellow PC gamers. 

[h1]DO IT LIVE![/h1]
With that being said, I'm excited to announce that ZWG will be going live just as soon as Valve approves the 1.0 build. 

[h1]Keyboard Mode[/h1]

No need to click! Now you can use your keyboard to type out the word you're looking to build. Some special keys to note:
[list]
[*] <backspace> to delete the last letter in the current word
[*] <space> to clear the entire current word
[*] <shift> Hold down shift to replace the last letter in the word. Press <shift>+<letter> repeatedly to cycle through different instances of a letter on the game board. 
[/list]
